claims.text: ERCOT recorded receiving Governor Abbott's directive letter on August 3rd, 2026, ordering a verification process before any data center Large Load advances through interconnection.
claims.quote: Today, August 3, 2026, Electric Reliability Council of Texas, Inc. (ERCOT) received a letter from Governor Greg Abbott directing ERCOT to conduct a verification process before advancing any data center Large Loads through the interconnection process.
claims.verbatim_quote: Today, August 3, 2026, Electric Reliability Council of Texas, Inc. (ERCOT) received a letter from Governor Greg Abbott directing ERCOT to conduct a verification process before advancing any data center Large Loads through the interconnection process.
claims.publisher: Electric Reliability Council of Texas
claims.document: ERCOT Market Notice M-A080326-01, Update Regarding Batch Zero Timelines and Processes

claims.text: The directive stopped ERCOT's Batch Zero clock. ERCOT stated it would not tell service providers how any Large Load was classified in the Batch Zero Interconnection Study by the August 7th, 2026 date.

claims.verbatim_quote: ERCOT will not notify each Interconnecting Distribution Service Provider and Transmission Service Provider of how any Large Load is classified in the Batch Zero Interconnection Study by August 7, 2026
claims.publisher: Electric Reliability Council of Texas

claims.text: ERCOT said it would seek a good cause exception from the Batch Zero timelines in Planning Guide Sections 5 and 9. The filing was to come ahead of the Public Utility Commission's August 20th, 2026 open meeting.
claims.quote: ERCOT will file, in advance of the Public Utility Commission of Texas's (PUCT's) August 20, 2026 open meeting, a request for a good cause exception related to the timelines and process for Batch Zero set forth in ERCOT Planning Guide Sections 5 and 9.
claims.verbatim_quote: ERCOT will file, in advance of the Public Utility Commission of Texas's (PUCT's) August 20, 2026 open meeting, a request for a good cause exception related to the timelines and process for Batch Zero set forth in ERCOT Planning Guide Sections 5 and 9.

claims.text: On August 3rd, 2026, Abbott directed the PUCT and ERCOT to run a comprehensive verification and audit of every data center advancing through ERCOT's interconnection process.
claims.quote: Governor Greg Abbott today directed the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) to conduct a comprehensive verification and audit of all data centers advancing through ERCOT's interconnection process.

claims.text: The audit is a gate rather than a study. No data center project moves forward until it is complete, and a project that fails the requirements is denied connection to the grid.

corrections.where: the August 3rd press release versus the signed letter, on the 474 figure
corrections.page_actually_says: The letter reads approximately 474 gigawatts. The press release reads approximately over 474 gigawatts. Use the letter.

corrections.where: the letter versus the press release, on the operative gate
corrections.page_actually_says: The release says before any data center project moves forward. The letter says before any additional data centers are approved to move forward, which is narrower. Both are held, as c11 and c12, and they are not interchangeable.

corrections.where: the letter versus the press release, on the commission's name
corrections.page_actually_says: The letter writes PUC throughout. The press release writes PUCT. Each quote carries whichever form its own source uses.

fetch_notes.status: HTTP 503 to this run's fetcher, HTTP 200 to curl with a browser User-Agent
fetch_notes.consequence: The status code was a fact about the fetcher rather than the host. Retested, the feed served 12,722 bytes and 32 entries. The deck's August 20th date is still attributed to ERCOT's notice, which names it in its own text.
Read as a document rather than through a text summary, so the letter quotes are verified against the document itself.
The five sentence block matched character for character. No update has been appended to the notice as of this run, which is an absence and therefore not a claim.
